redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Settings.Mode.H: Core: the simple workshop. Players pick a trade, search for an item, pay half its price in coin and play the mini-game. Extended: the full workshop with trade materials, gathering, recycling, buildings, farming and monster harvesting.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Title: RedVelvet Crafting
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Menu.Title: Workshop
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.1: Choose a trade and search for the item you want to craft. You can also drag an item onto the window.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.2: Crafting costs half the item's price in coin, paid when you start.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.3: You roll with the artisan's tools that fit the item if you own them, or Intelligence if you do not, against a DC set by the item's price.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.4: Three icons appear one after another. Click each while it glows gold. A better roll gives you a longer glow.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.5: Three hits craft the item and add it to your inventory.
redvelvet-crafting-dnd5e.Core.Rules.6: Two hits return half the coin, one hit returns a third, and no hits return nothing.
